description: This file implements diagnostic logging and heartbeat management for a system, including webhook event logging, session state tracking, and periodic heartbeat emissions.

methods.name: loadCommandPollBackoffRuntime
methods.description: Dynamically imports the command poll backoff runtime module.

methods.name: resolveStuckSessionWarnMs
methods.description: Calculates the stuck session warning threshold based on configuration.

methods.name: logWebhookReceived
methods.description: Logs the receipt of a webhook event.

methods.name: logWebhookProcessed
methods.description: Logs the processing of a webhook event.

methods.name: logWebhookError
methods.description: Logs an error related to webhook processing.

methods.name: logMessageQueued
methods.description: Logs a message being queued for processing.

methods.name: logMessageProcessed
methods.description: Logs the outcome of message processing.

methods.name: logSessionStuck
methods.description: Logs when a session is detected as stuck.

methods.name: logLaneEnqueue
methods.description: Logs enqueueing in a processing lane.

methods.name: logLaneDequeue
methods.description: Logs dequeueing from a processing lane.

methods.name: logRunAttempt
methods.description: Logs an attempt to run a session.

methods.name: logToolLoopAction
methods.description: Logs actions related to tool loops.

methods.name: startDiagnosticHeartbeat
methods.description: Starts periodic heartbeat emission for diagnostics.

methods.name: getDiagnosticSessionStateCountForTest
methods.description: Returns the count of diagnostic session states for testing.

methods.name: resetDiagnosticStateForTest
methods.description: Resets diagnostic state for testing purposes.
